messages:
maria_cs: Drafting a compact runbook for low-touch onboarding + renewal signal capture. Goal: give CS a checklist (prefill, batching, streaming fallback) + clear renewal-risk triggers so AE can act. PTAL and add missing steps. link: https://redwood.internal/notes/prefill-adaptive
jason_csm: Nice — can you call out exact thresholds where CS should open a renewal play? e.g., 7d drop in active sessions or 30% rise in latency/errors.
tamika_sre: Also need a short ops play: adaptive throttle params and what to do if KV cache misses spike. Add a quick command to surface the tenant's recent 24h tail latency.
chris_eng: Adding small runtime snippet below for adaptive throttle. Keep it advisory (CS won't edit prod, but SRE/Eng will).
chris_eng: ```yaml
adaptive_throttle:
  prefill_pool: 5        # number of warmed sessions to keep
  max_concurrent: 20
  slow_percentile_threshold_ms: 500  # 95th percentile
  error_rate_threshold_pct: 5
  burst_backoff_seconds: 600
  jitter_seconds: 30
  fallback_model: "smaller-1.5b"
``` 
maria_cs: perfect — I'll add this to the top of the runbook under "When to escalate". Suggested CS escalation triggers:
- sustained 3x latency above baseline for 2 hours
- error rate > 5% over 30m
- active user drop > 40% in 7d
- billing usage spike with no corresponding feature usage increase (possible loop)
alex_pm: For enablement, add two templated outreach messages: Day3 (warmup check) and Day14 (renewal sentiment + quick NPS). Keep templates short.
maria_cs: drafting templates now. Also adding a one-click feedback capture flow: short beta survey + example eval prompt set to surface hallucination or repetition issues.
jason_csm: I'd put the survey link in the runbook and a recommended cadence: Day3, Day7, Day21. Make it optional for low-touch but required for high-value tenants.
tamika_sre: Ops checklist bullet: if prefill pool depletion occurs, run: `redwood-admin prefill-stats --tenant <id> --last 24h` and then `sudo restart-prefill-worker <pool>` (ops only). Add reference to runbook's support playbook.
maria_cs: added ops commands and a short troubleshooting decision tree (prefill insurgent -> check batch size, KV misses, model fallbacks). Also added a small streaming recommendation: prefer streaming for human-facing flows; set max_stream_chunk_ms=100 to keep interactivity.
chris_eng: One more note: include how to temporarily lower model size for a tenant via rollout policy so CS can promise a fast mitigation while Eng does a permanent fix.
maria_cs: done. Will drop the PR to the internal docs next. Anyone want to quick review language for customer-facing tone? Keep it simple, directive, and non-technical where possible.
jason_csm: Happy to help edit tone later today. :thumbsup:
alex_pm: I'll review templates and ensure PM signoff on escalation thresholds.
ops-bot: incident-watch:prefill-depletion enabled for tenant-synthetic-123 (automated monitor created)
maria_cs: thanks all — merging this into the shared runbooks folder once jason/alex give final signoff. I'll ping AEs with the quick two-line play and link to the runbook.
